provenance.selection: First disjoint case per declared (PNRs, qubit band): (4,16–18),(5,19–20),(6,21–22). Roots sorted by ID; first five S3 routes; connected neighbours ordered unassigned first, then party size/CVM/ID; at most two options per PNR including incumbent. No solver or exact-reference outcomes used.
provenance.rich_selection: Additional first disjoint cases with (PNRs, max options per PNR)=(6,4),(8,3),(10,2), 23–36 logical qubits and reachable dimension <=262144. Assigned occupants come from the root first five S3 routes and a second hop through their first three alternatives. Include the first different-party-size neighbour where available, then party size/CVM/ID order. No solver/reference outcomes used; initial three controls retained.
provenance.scope: Outside bookings fixed; cases use independent copies of the same incumbent and cannot be summed.

reference.scope: Exact only for this restricted local option catalog with outside bookings fixed; PNR/passenger maxima may differ.

scope: Exact local references only; fixed outside bookings; no full-population QAOA allocation rate or speedup claim.

simulation: Exact invariant-subspace representation of the existing one-choice/slack-X circuit, not amplitude truncation. Qiskit gate-block matrices independently replay every optimized circuit; small cases also use full-state circuit checks.
